latest_news.headline: Iran publishes wider condition set for reopening Hormuz despite near-complete route talks
latest_news.text: Dawn’s agencies report says Iran now links reopening to U.S. compensation, an end to threats and attacks on Iran and its Lebanese, Palestinian, Yemeni and Iraqi allies, lifting the blockade and sanctions, and release of frozen assets. Iran and Oman still call route talks close; no traffic normalization has occurred.

latest_news.headline: Yemeni government says it counterattacked Houthis on multiple fronts after Marib shelling
latest_news.text: Reuters and Al Jazeera report the internationally recognized government said its forces struck Houthi capabilities and positions along multiple axes after renewed attacks on Marib. Reuters said the army gave no operational detail and the claims were not independently verified. The exchange raises wider-war risk but does not establish a separate canonical military_buildup threshold.

latest_news.headline: Saudi Arabia reaffirms right to defend territory and facilities against Houthi attacks
latest_news.text: Saudi Arabia welcomed the Aug. 7 UN Security Council statement and said it may take necessary measures under international law to defend its citizens, resources and facilities. Riyadh also renewed support for Yemen’s government and UN-led mediation. This is a material allied-position warning, not a newly observed strike.

latest_news.headline: India renews call for safe navigation after Indian-flagged vessel sinks in Red Sea
latest_news.text: India’s foreign ministry said protection of vessels and seafarers is a top priority and called for safe, unhindered navigation after the attacked MSV Faize Noore Oliya sank off Yemen; all 14 crew were rescued. This broadens allied maritime pressure but is not a force-deployment signal.

latest_news.headline: Russia says it struck military-linked vessels and port facilities in Odesa and Mykolaiv
latest_news.text: Reuters reported the Russian Defence Ministry said air-launched weapons and drones hit communications/electronic-warfare warehouses in Odesa, a cargo vessel and weapons warehouse in Mykolaiv, and another vessel in the Black Sea. Reuters presented the claims as Russian statements; independent confirmation was not located in this scan.

latest_news.headline: Iraqi militias postpone planned retaliation after mediation; Baghdad and Riyadh discuss security
latest_news.text: Reuters reported the Islamic Resistance in Iraq postponed a planned response to U.S.-Saudi strikes following an appeal by Hadi al-Amiri and political leaders. Iraq’s prime minister and the Saudi intelligence chief also discussed regional security. This meets the canonical diplomacy_active threshold and lowers raw/coupled risk from 45 to 42 while military_buildup remains active.

latest_news.headline: Israeli troops reportedly entered Lebanese-army-held pilot zone and built roadblock
latest_news.source: AFP via France 24; Al Jazeera/AFP; Lebanese NNA and military source
latest_news.summary: Israeli troops reportedly entered Zawtar al-Gharbiyah overnight and erected an earthen barrier about 100 metres from the town square. AFP observed the barrier; a Lebanese military source called the move a violation of the June framework. Three Lebanese soldiers were separately wounded while clearing unexploded ordnance.
latest_news.impact: Fresh evidence that the June framework remains under operational strain; confirms the already-active ceasefire_violation signal but does not exceed the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.

latest_news.summary: Three long-range drones hit the roof of a Wildberries warehouse in Yekaterinburg and started a fire. About 800 people were evacuated and no casualties were reported; the Kremlin discussed stronger infrastructure protection.
latest_news.impact: Material expansion of demonstrated Ukrainian strike reach, but the Russia-Ukraine tracker is already at a 99% ceiling and no canonical signal changes.

latest_news.impact: Important allied-position change and regional coupling consideration, but no nuclear-sharing change or Turkish nuclear signal; Turkey remains 5%.

latest_news.impact: Stronger multilateral pressure but no verified operational de-escalation; Yemen/Red Sea remains 85% with existing signals unchanged.

latest_news.headline: Congo completes first known prisoner transfer to AFC/M23 under Qatar deal

sources: International Committee of the Red Cross

latest_news.headline: African rights alliance seeks inquiry into Sudan chemical-weapons allegations

latest_news.headline: Houthi attacks kill scores in Yemen and wound 11 civilians in Saudi Arabia
latest_news.text: AFP reported 61 Yemeni government troops killed in ballistic-missile and drone attacks across Thursday-Friday, the worst losses since 2022. Saudi authorities separately said Houthi shelling in Najran wounded 11 civilians, including a four-year-old child; Yemen’s defence ministry promised a response. The EU and Canada subsequently condemned the attacks on Najran and Marib and called for an immediate halt; this is an allied-position update, not a new attack or an additional scoring input.

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Dawn's Aug. 9 agencies report adds the full Iranian condition set for reopening Hormuz: U.S. compensation, an end to threats and attacks on Iran and its regional allies, lifting the blockade and sanctions, and release of frozen assets. Iran and Oman still describe route talks as close, while the UAE reports another tanker hit. diplomacy_active, hormuz_controlled_not_closed and oil_infrastructure_threat remain active; the broader demands make implementation less certain but do not justify adding risk above the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Aug. 7 agreement on a shortlist of possible troop contributors for a future Hezbollah-disarmament verification force, renewing diplomacy_active after its older event instance reached TTL. Continuing truce violations keep ceasefire_violation active. Raw/coupled risk holds 95/100

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, AP and the signatories confirm the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement among Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and nuclear-armed Pakistan: an armed attack on one is to be treated as an attack on all. The pact is the scan's principal allied-position change, but its public text does not establish nuclear sharing and does not meet Türkiye's configured nuclear_rhetoric_official, diplomacy_active or missile_range_test thresholds; risk holds 5/deterrent

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The extended review found two Indian soldiers injured by a landmine in Poonch near the Line of Control on Aug. 6, but no independently verified cross-border clash or force deployment. The event does not meet the canonical military_buildup threshold; risk holds 15/ELEVATED

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h indexes produced humanitarian/context reporting but no independently corroborated new cross-border strike, clash or force buildup. Risk holds 46/critical

dashboard_trackers.notes: War remains at the model ceiling. Reuters reported Russia’s Defence Ministry said it struck military warehouses and vessels supporting Ukraine in Odesa, Mykolaiv and the Black Sea on Aug. 8; the specific claims were not independently verified in this scan. This confirms continued high-intensity war but does not establish a new canonical military_buildup event or change 99/IMMINENT

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Wall Street Journal, citing U.S. officials familiar with intelligence reporting, said the explosive-laden drone found at Leipzig/Halle likely belonged to the Russian government. German prosecutors have not publicly attributed the attack and NATO has announced no Article 4/5 action. This sharpens the hybrid-risk watch but activates neither configured russia signal; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80

dashboard_trackers.notes: Baseline PRC pressure persists. Reuters reported Taiwan coastal-strike drills, while Taiwan's MND said a PRC traffic-control order off Fujian during Typhoon Hana produced no abnormal ship or aircraft activity. Weather attribution and the absence of abnormal activity do not justify a new configured signal

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, AP and Yonhap confirm North Korea launched at least one short-range ballistic missile from Wonsan toward the sea east of the Korean Peninsula on Aug. 6, its first ballistic launch since late June and shortly before expected U.S.-ROK exercises. The canonical missile_range_test signal activates; raw risk rises 18→24 (ELEVATED). No nuclear test, ICBM launch, impact in Japan or strike on another state was reported

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: An Aug. 7 alliance of African rights groups called for an independent investigation into older allegations that Sudan's army used chemical weapons. The appeal and July sanctions are serious accountability context, but no fresh chemical attack, deployment or other configured event was independently verified in this scan. Risk holds 94/imminent with no new canonical signal

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UNICEF/OCHA document continuing attacks during the Gaza ceasefire. Reuters/AP now report Uganda approved conditional participation in the proposed International Stabilization Force, with Morocco also pledged; no deployment date exists and the plan remains stalled. ceasefire_violation and diplomacy_active are both active; the evidence-based near-ceiling probability holds 98/imminent

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN Security Council heard fresh warnings of institutional collapse, famine risk in four counties, deadly cholera and attacks on aid workers as the political settlement frays. This materially worsens humanitarian and political context but does not independently verify a new configured military_buildup, ceasefire_violation or diplomacy_refused event. Risk holds 19/elevated

dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters and Al Jazeera report that Yemen's internationally recognized government said it counterattacked Houthi positions on multiple fronts after renewed Marib shelling and the deadly Aug. 6-7 attacks. Saudi Arabia separately reaffirmed its right to defend its territory and facilities while supporting UN mediation. ceasefire_violation and diplomacy_active remain active; raw/coupled risk holds 85/85
